predict.question: B has 100 users at 50% activation and 100 at zero. What is B’s overall percentage?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: Lean Analytics distinguishes metrics that inform a business model from attractive counts without enough context.
modelBoundary: A and B both give {A}%. Scaling both cohorts tenfold scales activated users tenfold too, so the activation fraction does not improve. Cohort counts and rates are stipulated; no actual service or actionable-metric effect is measured.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Real-world applicability and the connection to the book remain unverified.
